items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: My brother went to him too.

ctx.x: I have to know, Jerry's a professor and never studied from him when he was in jail.

He's from here, he's from New Orleans, but he would come to Madisonville and go to Manderville, it'd be the spring at Covington, to all the schools, and donate most of each time to teach music to young students. My brother went to him too.
Well when you started on drums, did you say you had your own set, they had a couple sets in the band?
